verdict.rationale: The evidence covers dispute/chargeback handling for general card checkout (Crossmint absorbing dispute risk with banks) and order-lifecycle webhooks/polling, but no citation describes a refund API, refund initiation endpoint, or refund status tracking specifically for agent-placed orders (agent cards, agent checkouts, or wallet payments). Disputes and refunds are distinct concepts, and no programmatic refund mechanism is documented anywhere in the pack.
